# mistershell_report_template (Resource)

Manages a MisterShell report template.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mistershell_report_template" "example" {
  name               = "inventory-posture"
  report_type        = "inventory_posture"
  access_mode        = "public"
  ttl_hours          = 24
  ai_summary_enabled = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name.
- `report_type` (String) Report type.
- `ttl_hours` (Number) Ttl hours.

### Optional

- `access_mode` (String) Access mode.
- `ai_summary_enabled` (Boolean) Ai summary enabled.
- `allowed_role_ids` (Dynamic) Allowed role ids. Accepts a native Terraform value.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `filters` (Dynamic) Filters. Accepts a native Terraform value.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Created at.
- `created_by_user_id` (Number) Created by user id.
- `id` (String) Object identity. Import using this ID; resource variables use resource_id:stack_id.
- `updated_at` (String) Updated at.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import mistershell_report_template.example 123
```
